newsitem.title: JAPAN: S.Korea's Yukong says worried about price war.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea's Yukong says worried about price war.

text.p: An official of South Korea's Yukong Ltd on Tuesday expressed some concern that a price war could break out after market deregulation in South Korea next year.
Dong Woon Chung, Yukong petroleum's business planning director, said that whether a price war between refineries occured depended on whether they "compete or compromise".

"If they compete on a price basis, all are losers, there are no winners." he said, adding that aggressive competition at the refinery level was one scenario that might occur after South Korea's oil industry is liberalised on January 1.
He said a price war among service station owners was another possible scenario.
Yukong is South Korea's largest oil refiner with a refining capacity of 810,000 barrels per day.
